n: AI Basics for Schools (European Schoolnet Academy)
t: A free online course that teaches primary and secondary teachers the basics of AI.
steps: Find the AI Basics for Schools course on the European Schoolnet Academy site.
Check the current dates. The page lists 2021 dates.
Register a free account on the site.
Work through Module 1, What is AI.
Continue with Module 2, AI in Education, and Module 3, AI Benefits and Challenges.
Submit one activity and review three peer activities to earn the certificate.
